meta.name: caio-review
meta.description: /cs:caio-review <plan> — Eval-demanding Chief AI Officer interrogation of any plan that involves AI: model selection, risk classification, cost economics, or AI hiring. Use when shipping an AI feature without an eval set, choosing between API, fine-tune, and self-hosted, or classifying a use case under the EU AI Act.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估AI方案的模型选择、风险与成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要严格审查AI计划的模型、风险与成本
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate AI plans on model selection, risk, and cost
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a rigorous interrogation of AI plans covering model, risk, and cost

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像首席AI官一样审查你的AI计划，提出六个关键问题：评估标准、错误率SLO、欧盟AI法案风险等级、模型选择（API/微调/自建）、12个月成本轨迹、以及所需角色。
howto.when: 当你计划发布AI功能、签署AI供应商合同、在欧盟上线AI、招聘AI团队成员、或启动微调项目时触发。

say.text: 审查我的AI功能发布计划：模型选择、风险分类和成本。
say.note: Claude 会执行完整的CAIO审查流程。

say.text: 评估这个AI用例的欧盟AI法案风险等级。
say.note: Claude 会运行风险分类器并给出合规建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a Chief AI Officer, interrogating your AI plan with six questions: eval criteria, error SLO, EU AI Act risk tier, model choice (API/fine-tune/build), 12-month cost trajectory, and required role.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you plan to ship an AI feature, sign an AI vendor contract, launch AI in the EU, hire AI team members, or start a fine-tuning project.

say_en.text: Review my AI feature launch plan: model selection, risk classification, and cost.
say_en.note: Claude will run the full CAIO review process.

say_en.text: Classify this AI use case under the EU AI Act.
say_en.note: Claude will run the risk classifier and give compliance advice.
